title: Free fall onto the ball, open loop
description: Robot dropped 1 cm onto the ball, zero wheel torque. The upright pose is unstable: both engines topple, timing depends on rounding.
outcome: Both engines topple (open-loop unstable plant); first 0.6 s agree (early tilt RMS error ~1.9 deg), later timing differs.

title: Open-loop wheel-torque step
description: 2 N m on wheel 0 for 0.3 s (t = 0.5 to 0.8 s), no feedback. Forced response matches; later tilt diverges (unstable plant). Half speed.
outcome: Forced ball-speed response agrees to 5% of peak over the 0.3 s pulse; later tilt diverges as the plant is unstable.

title: LQR tracking 0.4 m/s
description: Model-based LQR (dz_nom gains), command 0.4 m/s along +x.
outcome: Both track 0.4 m/s with no fall; speed ratio 0.99 (CPU) vs 0.98 (Warp).

title: LQR tracking 0.8 m/s
description: Model-based LQR (dz_nom gains), command 0.8 m/s along +x.
outcome: Both track 0.8 m/s with no fall; speed ratio 1.03 (CPU) vs 1.04 (Warp).

title: Push: both engines recover
description: 1x body weight (39 N), 50 ms, direction 248 deg, while driving 0.4 m/s along +y. Half speed.
outcome: Both recover from a 1x body-weight, 50 ms push in this direction.

title: Push: both engines lose the ball
description: 1x body weight (39 N), 50 ms, direction 0 deg, while driving 0.4 m/s along +y. Half speed.
outcome: Both lose the ball after a 1x body-weight, 50 ms push in this direction.

title: Push at the edge: engines disagree
description: 1x body weight, 50 ms, direction 90 deg: in the sweep run CPU falls, Warp recovers; in this render CPU falls, Warp falls. Borderline case (GPU run is not bit-reproducible). Half speed.
outcome: Borderline push direction: in the 16-direction sweep CPU falls and Warp recovers (14 vs 12-13 of 16 directions fall in total); in this render both fall. The GPU run is not bit-reproducible, so the outcome of edge cases varies between runs.

title: LQR hold, robot dropped 2 cm onto the ball
description: Robot and ball dropped 2 cm from the settled pose with the LQR holding zero command. Compares the ball and wheel contact transient and the contact forces.
outcome: MuJoCo: stays upright, mean speed 0.00 m/s (cmd 0.00), max tilt 1.3 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 17.6 N; PhysX: stays upright, mean speed 0.00 m/s (cmd 0.00), max tilt 0.4 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 18.5 N
engines: PhysX 5 (Isaac Sim 6.2), roller-ring omni wheel emulation

title: Open-loop torque pulse, 0.5 Nm on wheels 0 and 2 for 0.1 s (0.3x speed)
description: No feedback: 0.5 Nm on wheels 0 and 2 for 0.1 s after 0.1 s of rest. The unstable plant is only comparable for the first 0.3 s; ball and body response is the check.
outcome: MuJoCo: stays upright, mean speed 0.05 m/s (cmd 0.00), max tilt 13.7 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 17.5 N; PhysX: stays upright, mean speed 0.07 m/s (cmd 0.00), max tilt 14.9 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 18.3 N
engines: PhysX 5 (Isaac Sim 6.2), roller-ring omni wheel emulation

title: LQR, 0.4 scaled speed
description: LQR (nominal gains) tracking 0.4 of the scaled speed along +x for 5 s.
outcome: MuJoCo: stays upright, mean speed 0.40 m/s (cmd 0.40), max tilt 9.8 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 17.8 N; PhysX: stays upright, mean speed 0.40 m/s (cmd 0.40), max tilt 8.5 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 18.8 N
engines: PhysX 5 (Isaac Sim 6.2), roller-ring omni wheel emulation

title: LQR, 0.8 scaled speed
description: LQR tracking 0.8 of the scaled speed along +x for 5 s.
outcome: MuJoCo: stays upright, mean speed 0.79 m/s (cmd 0.80), max tilt 10.0 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 18.0 N; PhysX: stays upright, mean speed 0.80 m/s (cmd 0.80), max tilt 8.8 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 20.5 N
engines: PhysX 5 (Isaac Sim 6.2), roller-ring omni wheel emulation

title: LQR, 1x body-weight 50 ms push at 1.5 s
description: One horizontal 50 ms push of 1x total weight (35 degrees from +x) while driving at 0.4 scaled speed.
outcome: MuJoCo: fell at 2.24 s, mean wheel-ball normal force 18.9 N; PhysX: fell at 1.89 s, mean wheel-ball normal force 20.4 N
engines: PhysX 5 (Isaac Sim 6.2), roller-ring omni wheel emulation

title: Contact zenith 66 deg, same 1x push
description: Design variant with the wheels at 66 degrees zenith (more upright contact) under the same push.
outcome: MuJoCo: stays upright, mean speed 0.38 m/s (cmd 0.40), max tilt 15.5 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 25.1 N; PhysX: stays upright, mean speed 0.39 m/s (cmd 0.40), max tilt 15.8 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 26.0 N
engines: PhysX 5 (Isaac Sim 6.2), roller-ring omni wheel emulation

title: Contact zenith 41 deg, same 1x push

engines: PhysX 5 (Isaac Sim 6.2), roller-ring omni wheel emulation

title: Contact zenith 41 deg, 0.8 scaled speed
description: Zenith 41 degree design at 0.8 scaled speed; MuJoCo with the same LQR loses balance.
outcome: MuJoCo: fell at 2.65 s, mean wheel-ball normal force 16.2 N; PhysX: stays upright, mean speed 0.79 m/s (cmd 0.80), max tilt 8.4 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 21.3 N
engines: PhysX 5 (Isaac Sim 6.2), roller-ring omni wheel emulation

title: PhysX naive import (isotropic capsule wheels), 0.4 scaled speed
description: What a plain MJCF to PhysX conversion gives: capsule wheels with one isotropic friction coefficient (the anisotropic <pair friction> cannot be represented). Failure case.
outcome: MuJoCo: stays upright, mean speed 0.40 m/s (cmd 0.40), max tilt 9.8 deg, mean wheel-ball normal force 17.8 N; PhysX naive: fell at 0.39 s, mean wheel-ball normal force nan N
